BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Can you tell me the historical events of Custer's Last Stand? ASSISTANT:

Custer's Last Stand was an iconic battle of the American West. It occurred on June 25, 1876, when George Custer and his forces of the United States Army were defeated by the Lakota Sioux and Northern Cheyenne at the Battle of Little Bighorn in Montana. Custer's forces were overwhelmed and Custer himself was killed in the battle.
